about: Steps of scripts/ci-local.mjs (CI on this machine). The Lead fits them to the stack at G3, the same as .github/workflows/ci.yml. "if": a path that must exist for the step to run. "changed": paths or globs; the step runs only when the branch changed one of them (a slow step that checks one part, such as a bundle). Every step gets CI_CHANGED_FILES, the path of a text file listing the changed files (empty text means every file), for a linter's include list. `ci-local.mjs staging --full` ignores "changed" and runs everything.
